chars.A: AYMANE: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide black stripe across the chest, black jogging trousers, white socks.
chars.H: HOUDA: a young woman (his older sister) wearing a lilac satin pyjama set with white piping.
chars.Y: YASMINE: a young woman (the sister's friend) wearing an oversized red-and-white horizontally striped long-sleeve top and black leggings.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, upstairs hallway of a modern Moroccan family apartment in Meknes with zellige tiles. HOUDA and YASMINE are giggling and pulling each other into a bedroom, HOUDA shutting the door with a cheeky look, while AYMANE stands in the hallway frowning at them with arms crossed, suspicious and embarrassed. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, AYMANE's small bedroom with a gaming poster-free plain wall, bed and desk. He sits on his bed, one earbud pulled out, pressing his ear against the shared wall, eyes wide, curious and uneasy. Dim lamp light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Morning flashback, bright light, hallway of the Moroccan apartment. YASMINE comes out of the sister's bedroom with messy clothes, looking caught and embarrassed, while AYMANE holding a backpack stares at her confused and suspicious.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark hallway of the apartment. AYMANE tiptoes barefoot in socks toward a closed bedroom door with a thin line of warm light under it, exaggerated sneaky cartoon pose, nervous face.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, AYMANE presses his ear against the closed wooden bedroom door, hand cupped to his ear, shocked face, warm light leaking under the door. Comic suspense.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AYMANE walking down the stairs of the Moroccan apartment, glancing back up at the closed bedroom door, puzzled and worried.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan kitchen with a small table: untouched breakfast of bread, msemen, olive oil, a teapot and two full glasses of mint tea, exactly as left. AYMANE stands next to it pointing at it, eyebrows raised, realizing something is off.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: AYMANE marching up the stairs with determined angry steps, fists clenched, toward the upstairs bedroom.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up: AYMANE's mitten hand on the handle of the closed bedroom door, his face frozen in shock, eyes wide, about to open it. Strong suspense.
